Name: (CP) Spouse Room Renovation
Author: EvhanCorinthi
Description:
[size=3]This mod uses three sub-mods to help integrate your spouse's room with the rest of your farmhouse:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][CP] Renovate:[/b] removes all original spouse furniture pieces and allows for changing the floor and wallpaper.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][CP] Relocate:[/b] allows moving the spouse room to one of four locations (any furniture placed will not move). Disabled with custom farmhouses and PolyamorySweet.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b][CP] Redecorate: [/b]adds a new catalogue for most of the removed spouse furniture.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Highly recommend:
[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿﻿ to use the in-game mod menu to change the room's location; otherwise read the included Readme.txt.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to be able to search the catalogue by spouse name (recommended way to search since some furniture was re-categorized).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ for animated furniture sprites.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip Mod[/url]﻿ so you can retrieve your furniture when you move the spouse room.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture [/url]﻿so you can nudge that beautiful piece into the absolute perfect spot.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[quote][center][color=#ff0000][size=3][u][b]My mod does not contain custom assets from any listed farmhouse, NPC, or expansion.[/b][/u][/size][/color][size=3]

My mod only contains assets found on vanilla tilesheets.

If you remove an expansion or NPC mod, you will lose access to that spouse's furniture.
I recommend removing the furniture from the farmhouse first before removing the custom mod.[/size][/center]
[/quote]
[left][size=3]Two toggles have since been added (access via GMCM):[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]one to remove Sebastian's frog sanctuary, and[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]one to remove Emily's parrot.[/size][/*]
[/list][/left]

**Most likely will not work with any other mod that changes or moves the spouse room**[/b][/size][/color][/center]


[size=4]﻿[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/u][/size][size=3]

There is one hard-coded tile in the spouse room where furniture or rugs cannot be placed; its designated as a spot for the spouse to stand. [CP] Spouse Room Renolocation 3.0.0 and later versions will allow you to move the spouse room to avoid that spot. At this time, relocating does NOT work with custom farmhouses or Polyamory Sweet.[/size]

[size=4][u][b]INSTALLATION:[/b][/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Delete previous version (You can save any config.json file. Just be sure to put each one back in the correct folder.)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download newest version.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip the downloaded file and copy to the Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/u][/size][size=3]

See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23529?tab=logs]changelog [/url]for latest details of updates.[/size]
[size=4]
[u][b]TRANSLATIONS:[/b][/u][/size][size=3]

Please do not upload separate translations for this mod. I would appreciate keeping everything together. If you would like to provide translations, please leave a comment on the Post page that includes a link to a json file using [url=https://smapi.io/json]smapi.io/json[/url]. Please see the files inside the i18n folders for what needs translating and to use as a template.

Chinese translations for [CP] Redecorate and [CP] Relocate provided by: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CNSCZJ]CNSCZJ[/url].
Korean translations for [CP] Redecorate provided by: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/4KMong]4KMong[/url]﻿.

[color=#ff00ff][b]**If you really enjoy this mod please consider hitting the endorsement button. Not only does it let me know the mod is working but it also allows more people to see the mod in the search results**[/b][/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Spouse Room Redecoration
Manifest.Description: Adds spouse furniture to Robin's shop and furniture catalogue.
Manifest.Author: EvhanCorinthi

Manifest.Name: (CP) Spouse Room Relocation
Manifest.Description: Allows the spouse room to be moved on the vanilla farmhouse only.
Manifest.Author: EvhanCorinthi

Manifest.Name: (CP) Spouse Room Renovation
Manifest.Description: Removes all furniture from the spouse room and allows you to place you own. You can even decorate the walls!
Manifest.Author: EvhanCorinthi
